## API Examples

```python
from mfaa.analyzer import EventFilter, PriorityScorer, PatternDetector
from mfaa.models import FilterConfig

# Filtering
config = FilterConfig(
    event_types=["Removed", "Created"],
    path_patterns=[r"^/Users/.*/Downloads/"],
    extensions=[".sh", ".command", ".app"]
)

filter = EventFilter(config)
filtered_events = filter.filter_events(events)

# Priority Scoring
scorer = PriorityScorer()
scored = scorer.score_events(filtered_events, xattr_records)

high_priority = scorer.get_high_priority_events(scored, min_score=60)

# Pattern Detection
detector = PatternDetector()
patterns = detector.detect_all_patterns(events)

for pattern in patterns:
    print(f"{pattern.severity}: {pattern.description}")
```
